import difflib, pathlib

src_root = pathlib.Path('C:/Users/md1avn/Documents/GitHub/neuron-channels/tasks/t0106_long_pdnd_nsga2_300gen/code')
dst_root = pathlib.Path('tasks/t0112_t0106_seed77_replicate/code')

src_files = {p.relative_to(src_root).as_posix() for p in src_root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
dst_files = {p.relative_to(dst_root).as_posix() for p in dst_root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}

print('=== files in src not in dst ===')
print(sorted(src_files - dst_files))
print('=== files in dst not in src ===')
print(sorted(dst_files - src_files))

# Filter diffs: ignore lines that mention only the t0106->t0112 rename and t0106->t0112 / T0106_ -> T0112_ in patched files
def norm(line):
    return line.replace('t0106_long_pdnd_nsga2_300gen', 't0112_t0106_seed77_replicate')

interesting = []
for rel in sorted(src_files & dst_files):
    a = (src_root / rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
    b = (dst_root / rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
    a_norm = [norm(l) for l in a]
    if a_norm == b:
        continue
    # Show only the actual deltas (after path-rewrite normalisation)
    diff = list(difflib.unified_diff(a_norm, b, fromfile=f'a/{rel}', tofile=f'b/{rel}', n=1))
    interesting.append((rel, diff))

print('=== files with non-trivial diffs (after path-rewrite normalisation) ===')
for rel, diff in interesting:
    print(f'-- {rel} --')
    for line in diff[:60]:
        print(line)
    print()
